secondArticle.desc: This agreement regulates the mutual rights and obligations of the parties in the purchase of medical advice or analysis services provided through online platforms by the Buyer (CONSULTATION PURCHASER and/or SERVICE USER).
laws: The medical consultation service provided by SİNAPSMED LLC CANNOT BE CONSIDERED A SUBSTITUTE FOR ANY MEDICAL SERVICE provided by the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Azerbaijan.
The organization of treatment and prevention work in the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan is solely the responsibility of the Ministry of Health and its certified institutions and individuals.
The package of services cannot be considered a substitute for a traditional medical examination in cases where the patient and doctor must be together.

In situations where you need to see a doctor directly for medical diagnosis and treatment of illnesses, and in emergencies, you should call the emergency medical number of your place of residence without delay.

The medication(s) recommended to the recipient of the consultation as a result of an online meeting by a doctor cannot be substituted for a prescription; prescriptions that allow for the use of the medication can only be written by doctors providing services in institutions certified by the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Azerbaijan.

The Buyer (and/or the CONSULTANT RECIPIENT and/or the SERVICE USER) has been informed in detail and his/her consent has been obtained on these matters through the "USER INFORMATION AND CONSENT AGREEMENT" provided in the appendix to this agreement.

The term of this agreement begins with the payment of the predetermined amount by the Buyer (and/or CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or SERVICE USER) together with the mutual rights and obligations of the parties, and ends with the provision of the service that is the subject of the agreement by the specialist or consultant doctor or psychologist or dietician on the appointment date determined by the online platforms.
article2.title: TERM OF THE CONTRACT

article3.desc: The amount to be charged for the services referred to in this agreement is the amount notified to the Buyer (and/or CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or SERVICE USER) and posted on the internet portal (www.sinapsmed.com) where the service was purchased.
article3.title: CONTRACT PRICE

laws: The package of services will provide the CONSULTATION RECEIVER and/or SERVICE USER with the opportunity to receive advice on relevant topics from a specialist doctor or consultant doctor or psychologist or dietitian, in accordance with the service chosen.
Appointment details for the service package purchased by the BUYER online will be sent to the email address provided by the BUYER during registration.
The time of provision of the consultation service is the time chosen by the BUYER as the appointment date.
The duration of meetings with doctors is as long as the doctor deems necessary, with a maximum of 30 (THIRTY) minutes.

The DOCTOR may recommend that the SERVICE USER undergo various tests (analysis) or radiological examinations. These tests are not included in the service received and can be performed by 3rd party institutions for the SERVICE USER upon payment or by 3rd party institutions that have an agreement with Sinapsmed LLC upon payment on the sinapsmed.com portal.
The doctor may choose to have an online meeting or a phone call to review the test results. This is entirely up to the dietitian's discretion.

The CONSULTANT and/or SERVICE USER has the right to a free follow-up appointment with the doctor within 10 (TEN) days from the end of the appointment to show the test and analysis results. The importance and number of these appointments are decided by the DOCTOR. The follow-up appointment will be organized by the SİNAPSMED management team and the appointment date will be communicated to you.

If the CONSULTANT and/or SERVICE USER wishes to meet with the DOCTOR again within a period exceeding 10 (TEN) days from the end of the appointment, they must register, pay and make an appointment as before.
The duration of meetings with a dietitian is as long as the dietitian deems necessary, with a maximum of 30 (THIRTY) minutes.

The dietician may recommend that the SERVICE USER undergo various tests (analysis) or radiological examinations. These tests are not included in the service received and can be performed by 3rd party institutions for the SERVICE USER upon payment or by 3rd party institutions that have an agreement with Sinapsmed LLC upon payment on the sinapsmed.com portal.
The dietitian may choose to meet online or via email or phone to review the test results. This is entirely at the discretion of the dietitian.

The CONSULTANT and/or SERVICE USER has the right to a free follow-up meeting with the dietitian within 10 (TEN) days from the end of the appointment to show the test and analysis results. The importance and number of these meetings are decided by the DIETITIAN. The follow-up meeting will be organized by the SİNAPSMED management team and the appointment date will be communicated to you.

If the CONSULTANT and/or SERVICE USER wishes to meet with the DIETITIAN again within a period exceeding 10 (TEN) days from the end of the appointment, they must register, pay and make an appointment as before.
Each session scheduled at a psychologist's appointment lasts 45 (FORTY-FIVE) minutes.
The CONSULTANT and/or SERVICE USER may communicate with the psychologist via email outside of the session, but the psychologist is not obligated to respond to these emails.

In the event of delays in the implementation of the appointment, the PURCHASER (and/or CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or SERVICE USER) will be informed by the SİNAPSMED management team and will be given the options of changing the appointment date or refunding the entire amount paid to the sender.

If for any reason the service fee is not paid by the BUYER (and/or CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or SERVICE USER) or is canceled by the bank, the SERVICE PROVIDER is deemed to be released from the obligation to provide the service package, and SİNAPSMED LLC is deemed to be released from the obligation to mediate.

This agreement comes into effect when the BUYER ticks the CONFIRMATION box located on the appointment booking page on the portal, next to which a link is placed to display the “USER INFORMATION AND CONSENT AGREEMENT” in a legible form in addition to the DISTANCE SALES AGREEMENT; the appointment is fulfilled by the provision of the service in an online environment by the SERVICE PROVIDER to the BUYER (and/or CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or SERVICE USER) at the time of the appointment.
article4.title: MAIN FEATURES OF THE SUBJECT OF THE CONTRACT:

laws: The BUYER (and/or CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or SERVICE USER) declares that he/she has read, understood, been fully informed, informed and electronically confirmed the information provided online by the Seller (SİNAPSMED portal) regarding the features, price and payment method of the service package.

In order to implement the service package he/she has chosen, the BUYER (and/or CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or SERVICE USER) expressly consents to the recording, processing and storage of the personal data provided by him/her upon registration to the SİNAPSMED.COM portal and the personal medical data obtained by the doctor during the appointment, subject to the limited use in medical and scientific research, as well as for the development of the services provided by the portal.

The DOCTOR has the right to prepare a medical history for each PATIENT (PATIENT) by entering the necessary medical/non-medical information, including the patient's name, surname, patronymic, date and place of birth, address, and ID card number, and store it in the doctor's personal archive. The doctor will transfer the prepared medical history to the SİNAPSMED portal after the appointment, and this information will be processed by the SİNAPSMED portal and archived in the portal's providers.

The psychologist also has the right to collect and store data as stated in paragraph 3, but this data is NOT REQUIRED by the SİNAPSMED portal in ANY CASE. The SİNAPSMED portal only has the right to record, process and store all data entered during registration.

The Buyer (and/or the CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or the SERVICE USER) may submit their requests and complaints to the Seller (SİNAPSMED portal) at info@sinapsmed.com. The BUYER (and/or the CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or the SERVICE USER) will evaluate these requests and complaints as soon as possible and respond to the BUYER (and/or the CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or the SERVICE USER) via the contact information provided when registering for the appointment.

If for any reason the service fee is not paid by the BUYER (and/or CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or SERVICE USER) or is canceled by the bank, the SERVICE PROVIDER is deemed to be released from the obligation to provide the service package, and the SİNAPSMED portal is deemed to be released from the obligation to act as an intermediary.

In cases where the CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or SERVICE USER does not attend the meeting to be held via video, audio or messaging at the appointed time, the Seller (SİNAPSMED LLC) is not obligated to refund the amount paid.

This agreement shall enter into force for the parties indicated in ARTICLE-1 upon the BUYER checking the CONFIRMATION box located on the appointment booking page of the portal, next to which, in addition to the DISTANCE SALES AGREEMENT, a link is also placed to view the “USER INFORMATION AND CONSENT AGREEMENT” in a legible form; the appointment shall be fulfilled by the provision of the service in an online environment by the SERVICE PROVIDER to the BUYER (and/or CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or SERVICE USER) at the time of the appointment.

By confirming this agreement online/electronically, the BUYER (and/or CONSULTATION RECIPIENT and/or SERVICE USER) confirms that he/she has received complete and accurate information about the consulting service provided by the SERVICE PROVIDER.

The SİNAPSMED portal reserves the right to make amendments or changes to the text of these agreements in the future without any notice to the BUYER (and/or CONSULTATION PURCHASER and/or SERVICE USER).
